capabilities: Track active time, editing time, typed characters, and file-open counts per file
Exclude idle, sleep, and lock-screen gaps from tracked activity
Explore daily and historical activity by folder, drilling into files
Open a pinnable activity chart from eligible file headers
Export results as a theme-matched PNG poster with an optional caption
extras: Bilingual docs (English and Simplified Chinese); the README stresses local-first behavior: no account, telemetry, network upload, and no reading or storing of note content or typed strings. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
problem: Obsidian gives no view of how much focused time you actually spend on each file or folder, so usage patterns are invisible.
summary: Activity tracker that records focused time, editing time, typed characters, and file-open counts per file and folder in the vault.
